dedupe_keys.name: geff era5 global fire danger reanalysis canadian fire weather indices

description: GEFF-ERA5 is a global reanalysis of fire danger indices computed with the Global ECMWF Fire Forecast (GEFF) model from ECMWF reanalysis weather. The dataset described by Vitolo and others (Scientific Data, 26 February 2019) spans 38 years from 1980 and provides seven fields of the Canadian Fire Weather Index system, including the Fire Weather Index, as global grids; the first release was forced with ERA-Interim, and the archive is updated yearly. Its authors are at ECMWF and the European Commission Joint Research Centre, and it complements the Global Wildfire Information System. The data are available free as Zenodo archives of about 7 GB per index. Caveats: indices describe weather-driven fire danger, not fuel availability or ignition, and coarse reanalysis grids smooth local extremes. It provides long hazard series for climatological wildfire exposure of power lines, rail and other infrastructure and for training fire risk models; a related record is the State of Wildfires exposure datasets.
